3. Vide order dated 06.03.2017 notice was issued to the opposite party no.2.
As per the office report dated 02.09.2025 a report regarding service of notice has been received.
The report dated 03.01.2019 of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jaunpur is on record which states that notice has been served on the opposite party no.2 through heirs.

"It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to, allow the application and set-aside the order dated 12.01.2017 passed by Prabhari Special Judge POCSO Act, Additional Session Judge Court No.1, Jaunpur In case Crime No. 299/2016 (State Versus Rajendra) POSCO Act U/s 363,366,376 I.P.C.
P.S. Sarpathan District Jaunpur.
